name.en: MG RGM-79[G] Ground combat type gym

description.ja: OVAシリーズ「機動戦士ガンダム　第０８ＭＳ小隊」に登場するＭＳ「陸戦型ジム」を商品化。劇中に登場した豊富な武器をくまなく付属します。
description.en: Commercialization of the MS "Land Battle Type Jim " that appears in the OVA series " Mobile Suit Gundam 08th MS Platoon". A wide variety of weapons that appeared in the movie are included.

description.ja: とくに、劇中後半に登場し活躍した「スナイパーライフル」も付属します。
description.en: In particular, the "sniper rifle" that appeared and played an active role in the latter half of the movie is also included.
